page.title: System Control
page.description: Git status for registered projects and compressed backups written to /root/backup.

git.title: Git Control
git.description: Hermes and every registered project with a working directory. Add a project on its own registration page.
git.stageAndCommit_one: Stages {{count}} pending file and commits. Does not push.
git.stageAndCommit_other: Stages {{count}} pending files and commits. Does not push.

backups.title: Backups
backups.noWorkingDirectory: This project has no working directory set yet
backups.description: Archives are kept separate by target: Hermes and each project write to their own directory. Enable backup for a project on its registration page.
backups.deleteDescription: Permanently removes this backup archive. This action cannot be undone.
backups.pickTarget: Pick a target above to browse or delete its archives. All is only for running backups.

cleanup.title: Cleanup
cleanup.updatingTitle: A category was cleared; the host filesystem scan is still updating the counts.
cleanup.emptyTrashTitle: Permanently deletes everything in trash. This cannot be undone.
cleanup.runTitle: Runs the bounded cleanup policy used by the weekly Athos cron
cleanup.description: Read-only inventory of logs, backups, cron output, and old or duplicate scripts. Files cleared here go to trash; use Empty trash to delete them permanently. Run cleanup also applies the weekly Athos policy: it expires manual backups after 30 days, bounds temporary files and journals, and prunes inactive reproducible Docker artifacts. Docker volumes, databases, live agent logs, sessions, knowledge, and scripts are never deleted by this action.
cleanup.runConfirmDescription: Runs the weekly Athos cleanup now. Expired files and trash are permanently deleted, and reproducible Docker artifacts are pruned. Docker volumes and databases are excluded.
cleanup.emptyConfirmDescription: Everything currently in trash will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone, is not part of the weekly policy, and only runs when you confirm here.
cleanup.completed: Weekly ecosystem cleanup completed with policy {{policy}}.
cleanup.scanFailed: Failed to scan for cleanup candidates.
cleanup.clearDescription: Moves every file in this category to trash, where it remains recoverable. The weekly cleanup policy is unaffected.

terminal.title: Terminal Sessions
terminal.description: Every live forgehub-* tmux session on the host, even without an open Workspace tab. A tab closed by a browser crash or reload outside the Workspace close button can leave its session running indefinitely; end it here to free resources. This list is read directly from the host.
terminal.killDescription: Ends the tmux session and any process still running inside it. This cannot be undone.

chatSessions.title: Chat Sessions
chatSessions.resetAllTitle: Reset every stale session with one confirmation
chatSessions.description: Workspace conversations with Hermes agents that resume a session, checked against the profile's store on the host. A session can become stale when Hermes prunes or rebuilds it; later messages fail until it is reset. Reset only forgets the resume link in ForgeHub and preserves the Hermes history.
chatSessions.resetDescription: Forgets the resumed Hermes session so the next message starts a fresh one. Conversation history in ForgeHub is kept; only Hermes continuity is lost.
chatSessions.resetAllFailed: Failed to reset one or more sessions
chatSessions.resetAllDescription: Forgets the Hermes resume link for every stale session. The next message in each starts a fresh session. ForgeHub conversation history is kept.
chatSessions.deleteDescription: Permanently deletes "{{title}}" and all its messages from ForgeHub. This cannot be undone.

build_cache.title: Clear Docker build cache?
build_cache.description: Deletes the whole BuildKit cache (docker builder prune --all). Nothing running is affected; the next build of each project is slower while its layers are rebuilt.
build_cache.label: Clear build cache

unused_images.title: Remove unused Docker images?
unused_images.description: Deletes every image no container uses (docker image prune --all), including rollback tags such as forgehub-frontend:rollback-*. Images of running or stopped containers are kept. Volumes are never touched.
unused_images.label: Remove images

all.title: Clean Docker build cache and unused images?
all.description: Deletes the whole BuildKit cache and every image no container uses, including rollback tags. Running services are not affected and volumes are never touched.
all.label: Clean all

backupFiles.title: Backup files
backupFiles.description: Includes /root/backup, the weekly Hermes archive (newest archive protected), rollback snapshots and dumps in /tmp. Items go to the trash; space is freed when you empty it. System backups (/var/backups) and project source files are not listed.
backupFiles.protectedNewest: Newest weekly Hermes backup (latest recovery point)
backupFiles.moved_one: Moved {{count}} item ({{size}}) to {{path}}. Empty the trash in the Cleanup card to free the space.
backupFiles.moved_other: Moved {{count}} items ({{size}}) to {{path}}. Empty the trash in the Cleanup card to free the space.
backupFiles.confirmDescription_one: {{count}} item ({{size}}) will be moved to the trash. It can be restored until the trash is emptied; after that, deletion is permanent.
backupFiles.confirmDescription_other: {{count}} items ({{size}}) will be moved to the trash. They can be restored until the trash is emptied; after that, deletion is permanent.
